description: This file contains PHPUnit test cases for the EmailQueueService class in the OrangeHRM project. It tests various functionalities such as getting the email DAO, adding emails to the queue, sending emails, resetting email services, and changing mail statuses. The class extends KernelTestCase and uses mock objects to verify behavior.

classes.name: EmailQueueServiceTest
classes.description: Test suite for the EmailQueueService class, containing test methods for its core functionalities, including queue management and email sending.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes the test environment and populates test data before each test.

methods.name: testGetEmailQueueDao
methods.description: Verifies that getEmailQueueDao returns an instance of EmailQueueDao.

methods.name: testGetEmailService
methods.description: Checks that getEmailService method is called correctly.

methods.name: testAddToQueue
methods.description: Tests adding an email to the queue, verifying the Mail object's properties.

methods.name: testSendSingleMail
methods.description: Verifies the sequence of setting email message properties and sending a single email using mocks.

methods.name: testResetEmailService
methods.description: Tests resetting the email service with a fresh Mail object.

methods.name: testChangeMailStatus
methods.description: Checks changing mail status to started and sent, ensuring properties are correctly updated.

methods.name: testSendAllPendingMails
methods.description: Simulates fetching all pending mail IDs and ensures sending each email, verifying method calls.
